goal: Migrate order and report loading from legacy_fetch to the typed OrdersClient without a big-bang cutover

phases.name: Expand — add the new path beside the old

steps.description: Add OrdersClient with the same return shapes as legacy_fetch, behind no callers
steps.rollback: Delete the new module; nothing depends on it yet

steps.description: Add characterization tests capturing legacy_fetch's current responses for /orders and /reports
steps.rollback: Remove the tests; they change no behavior

steps.description: Switch load_order and load_orders to OrdersClient behind the orders_client feature flag
steps.rollback: Turn the orders_client flag off; the legacy path is still wired

steps.description: Switch refresh to OrdersClient under the same flag and enable the flag for 10% of traffic
steps.rollback: Set the flag to 0%; both paths remain deployed

steps.description: Switch monthly_report to OrdersClient and raise the flag to 100%
Point test_orders.py at OrdersClient and delete the legacy_fetch mock
steps.rollback: Restore the previous test file from version control

steps.description: Verify no call sites of legacy_fetch remain (map_migration_scope.py reports totalSites 0) and the flag has been 100% for two weeks
steps.rollback: Nothing to undo; a non-zero count stops the phase

steps.description: Remove the feature flag and the legacy module
steps.rollback: none — the legacy module is gone from the build; this step is last and follows the verification
